Checkpoint saved (minute 11) so work is safe, but stopping at maintenance means results miss the deadline. Given we just had a hardware fault, I'd recommend one fresh checkpoint (protects ~37 min of progress) as cheap insurance — checkpoint engineer, worth doing if run can spare 10 min before minute ~90.

Training eng: run-A healthy, no errors. At min 65 it has 35 min of compute left → finishes ~min 100. Maintenance at 119 (after overrides) gives 19 min margin; results due 110 gives a 10-min buffer. Checkpoints (11/33/69) all safe. Root cause for future runs: ensure export_metrics is granted to training engineer before the run, and route result export at the start of the final handoff, not after. Thanks to infra for the rescue export.

Training eng: Acknowledged. run-A trained clean to minute 100; results exported by infra at 119 (preserved before maintenance). Deadline missed ~9 min solely due to the export_metrics access gap — I didn't have the tool and IT needs 1-2 business days to grant it. Lesson recorded: I need export_metrics granted pre-run, and result export should be triggered at the start of the final handoff. Thanks to infra for the rescue. Nothing further from training side; maintenance in progress.

Budget Controller: Acknowledged — compute budget held (1/1 extension, overrides per emergency authorization; no overspend).
